questions.stem: What is digital estate in your own words?
questions.zhStem: 数字资产是什么？请用你自己的话说。
options: Only the servers that will move to Azure first
All servers, applications, data, and the connections between them
Only the software licenses and support contracts the company owns
The Azure subscriptions and resource groups already created
questions.explain: The digital estate is everything IT runs today, because it covers all servers, applications, data, and how they connect, not just the first servers to move.
questions.zhExplain: 数字资产是 IT 当前运行的全部内容，因为它涵盖所有服务器、应用、数据以及它们之间的连接，而不只是最先迁移的服务器。

questions.stem: Why is understanding the digital estate necessary before planning a cloud migration?
questions.zhStem: 为什么了解数字资产是规划云迁移之前的必要工作？
options: Azure refuses to create VMs until an inventory file is uploaded
Azure Migrate can only replicate servers listed in a spreadsheet
Sizing, cost, and migration order depend on what exists and how it connects
Licensing rules require a signed inventory before any migration
questions.explain: The team must know the full estate first, because VM sizing, cost, and migration order all depend on what exists and how it connects.
questions.zhExplain: 团队必须先了解完整的数字资产，因为虚拟机规格、成本和迁移顺序都取决于有哪些资源以及它们如何连接。

questions.stem: What are three risks of migrating without adequate discovery and assessment?
questions.zhStem: 有哪三个风险会出现在没有充分发现和评估的迁移中？
options: Higher licensing fees, slower Internet, and data loss in Azure
Azure refusing VMs, expired subscriptions, and lost backups
Outages, late-found blockers, and wrong size and cost
Longer replication, extra appliances, and more vCenter accounts
questions.explain: The three risks are outages, late blockers, and wrong sizing, because missed dependencies, unsupported operating systems, and missing usage data only show up through discovery and assessment.
questions.zhExplain: 三个风险是停机、阻碍因素发现太晚和规格错误，因为遗漏的依赖、不受支持的操作系统和缺失的使用数据只有通过发现和评估才能暴露。

questions.stem: What is the discovery approach and how does it work at a high level?
questions.zhStem: 发现方法是什么？它在高层次上如何工作？
options: Deploy the Azure Migrate appliance on vCenter and collect data for about 30 days
Install a discovery agent on each VM and collect data for one hour
Export a user list from Active Directory and import it as performance data
Replicate every VM to Azure first, then measure usage there
questions.explain: The approach is agentless discovery with the Azure Migrate appliance on vCenter, because the appliance reads every VM through vCenter and about 30 days of data captures peak usage.
questions.zhExplain: 该方法是用部署在 vCenter 上的 Azure Migrate 设备进行无代理发现，因为设备通过 vCenter 读取每台 VM 的数据，约 30 天的数据能捕捉到使用高峰。

questions.stem: What is the role of the Azure Migrate appliance and its connection to vCenter?
questions.zhStem: Azure Migrate 设备的作用是什么？它与 vCenter 如何连接？
options: It installs an agent on each VM through Remote Desktop
It needs a domain admin account with write access to every VM
It reads VM data from vCenter Server with a read-only account over port 443
It copies VM disk files to Azure Storage and scans them there
questions.explain: The appliance uses a read-only vCenter account over port 443, because it reads VM configuration and performance through the vSphere APIs without installing anything on the servers.
questions.zhExplain: 设备通过 443 端口使用只读的 vCenter 账户，因为它通过 vSphere API 读取虚拟机配置和性能，无需在服务器上安装任何东西。

questions.stem: What configuration and performance information would you collect?
questions.zhStem: 你会收集哪些配置和性能信息？
options: Only server names and IP addresses
Configuration, performance, installed software, and server dependencies
Only the monthly Azure cost for each server
Application source code and its build history
questions.explain: Discovery collects configuration, performance, software, and dependencies, because assessment later needs all of these facts to judge readiness, size, and cost.
questions.zhExplain: 发现会收集配置、性能、软件和依赖关系，因为后续评估需要这些事实来判断就绪度、规格和成本。

questions.stem: What distinguishes discovering assets from assessing their suitability for migration?
questions.zhStem: 发现资产与评估其迁移适用性有什么区别？
options: Discovery estimates cost; assessment lists which servers exist
Discovery runs in Azure; assessment runs only on-premises
Discovery moves servers; assessment tests them after the move
Discovery collects server facts; assessment uses them to judge readiness, size, and cost
questions.explain: Discovery gathers facts and assessment judges them, because assessment turns the collected data into readiness, VM size, and monthly cost.
questions.zhExplain: 发现负责收集事实，评估负责判断，因为评估把收集到的数据转化为就绪度、虚拟机规格和月度成本。

questions.stem: How would you validate assumed dependencies during discovery?
questions.zhStem: 你会如何在发现期间验证假设的依赖关系？
options: Check each server's OS version in the vCenter inventory
Shut down DC-01 in production and see what breaks
Run dependency analysis and look for connections to DC-01 on ports 88, 389, or 53
Read the VM size recommendation in the assessment report
questions.explain: Agentless dependency analysis validates them, because it shows each server's TCP connections with process and port, such as traffic to DC-01 on ports 88, 389, or 53.
questions.zhExplain: 无代理依赖分析可以验证这些假设，因为它会显示每台服务器的 TCP 连接及其进程和端口，例如发往 DC-01 的 88、389 或 53 端口的流量。

questions.stem: How does dependency analysis reduce the risk of outages?
questions.zhStem: 依赖分析如何降低停机风险？
options: So servers that depend on each other move together and nothing is cut off
So Azure can choose a cheaper region for each server
So the team can skip the readiness assessment
So each server can be migrated in a separate month
questions.explain: It reduces outages, because servers that depend on each other move together and none is left cut off from what it needs.
questions.zhExplain: 它能减少停机，因为相互依赖的服务器会一起迁移，没有服务器会与所需资源断开。

questions.stem: What one logical migration group would you propose, and why do its servers belong together?
questions.zhStem: 你会提出哪一个逻辑迁移组？为什么其中的服务器应放在一起？
options: All five servers, because they share the same domain
WEB-01, APP-01, and DB-01, because they form one application
APP-01 and FILE-01, because both run Windows Server
DB-01 and DC-01, because both are business-critical
questions.explain: WEB-01, APP-01, and DB-01 form one group, because they are one application and splitting them would send database traffic over the VPN.
questions.zhExplain: WEB-01、APP-01 和 DB-01 构成一组，因为它们是同一个应用，拆开迁移会让数据库流量走 VPN。

questions.stem: What is the Readiness Category of FILE-01?
questions.zhStem: 就绪类别中，FILE-01 属于哪一类？
options: Ready, because Azure VMs can run any Windows version
Insufficient Information, because the file share sizes are unknown
Conditionally Ready, because it only needs a DNS change
Not Ready, because the OS will no longer get security patches
questions.explain: FILE-01 is Not Ready, because an out-of-support OS with no security patches is a blocker that needs an OS upgrade during migration.
questions.zhExplain: FILE-01 属于未就绪（Not Ready），因为不再获得安全补丁的过期操作系统是一个阻碍因素，需要在迁移时升级操作系统。

questions.stem: How does Azure Migrate support Azure VM sizing and cost estimation?
questions.zhStem: Azure Migrate 如何支持 Azure VM 规格确定和成本估算？
options: It maps collected configuration and performance data to VM sizes and prices them
It applies a fixed global price list that ignores the region
It always picks the largest VM size to be safe
It uses manual estimates typed in by the server owners
questions.explain: Azure Migrate sizes and prices VMs from collected data, because the assessment maps each server's configuration and performance to a VM size and disk type and prices them for the chosen region and pricing options.
questions.zhExplain: Azure Migrate 根据收集的数据确定 VM 规格并计价，因为评估会把每台服务器的配置和性能映射到 VM 规格和磁盘类型，并按所选区域和定价选项计价。

questions.stem: What is the difference between performance-based sizing and as-is sizing?
questions.zhStem: 基于性能的规格确定与按现状规格确定有什么区别？
options: Performance-based copies current specs; as-is uses actual usage over time
Both use actual usage, but as-is adds a safety buffer
Performance-based uses actual usage over time; as-is copies current specs
Both copy current specs, but performance-based adds Premium SSD
questions.explain: Performance-based sizing right-sizes VMs from actual usage, because it uses CPU, memory, and disk data over time, while as-is sizing copies on-premises specs and often oversizes.
questions.zhExplain: 基于性能的规格确定能根据实际使用情况合理确定 VM 规格，因为它使用一段时间内的 CPU、内存和磁盘数据，而按现状规格确定照搬本地配置，常常规格过大。

questions.stem: What are three factors that could affect the estimated Azure operating cost?
questions.zhStem: 哪三个因素可能影响估算的 Azure 运营成本？
options: Server names, IP addresses, and domain names
VM size and disk type, licensing, and commitment
vCenter version, appliance OS, and port 443
Diagram style, Markdown files, and GitHub folders
questions.explain: VM size and disk type, licensing, and commitment drive the cost, because compute and storage are most of the bill, Azure Hybrid Benefit reuses licenses, and reserved instances cost less than pay-as-you-go.
questions.zhExplain: VM 规格和磁盘类型、许可和承诺期会影响成本，因为计算和存储占账单的大头，Azure Hybrid Benefit 复用现有许可证，预留实例比即用即付便宜。

questions.stem: What high-level migration plan considers business criticality, dependencies and migration groups, downtime constraints, migration risk, and readiness and required remediation?
questions.zhStem: 什么样的高层迁移计划能兼顾业务关键性、依赖关系和迁移组、停机限制、迁移风险以及就绪度和所需修复？
options: Most critical server first, each server alone, no maintenance window
All servers at once, with blockers fixed after cutover
Random order, with DB-01 moved before its dependency analysis
Lowest risk first, dependent servers together, one window, blockers fixed first
questions.explain: The plan moves from lowest to highest risk with dependent servers together, because the process is proven on less critical servers before DB-01, and blockers are fixed before each move.
questions.zhExplain: 该计划从低风险到高风险推进，相互依赖的服务器一起迁移，因为流程要先在不太关键的服务器上验证后再迁移 DB-01，而阻碍因素要在每次迁移前修复。

questions.stem: What order of the remaining workloads or groups would you propose, and why?
questions.zhStem: 你会为其余工作负载或迁移组提出什么顺序？为什么？
options: DB-01 first, then APP-01, WEB-01, FILE-01, and DC-01 last
New DC, then FILE-01, then WEB-01, APP-01, and DB-01 together, then retire DC-01
Retire DC-01 first, then move all other servers in one window
FILE-01 last, after group 1, because it is the oldest server
questions.explain: The new DC goes first and DC-01 is retired last, because every server needs sign-in and DNS, and group 1 waits until the SQL assessment of DB-01 is done.
questions.zhExplain: 新的域控制器排在第一步，DC-01 最后退役，因为每台服务器都需要登录和 DNS，而迁移组 1 要等 DB-01 的 SQL 评估完成后再迁移。

questions.stem: What condition would trigger rollback, and what is the high-level recovery approach?
questions.zhStem: 什么条件会触发回滚？高层恢复方法是什么？
options: A failed check fixable next week; keep Azure live
Any warning in the logs; delete the original servers
A failed check not fixable in the window; point DNS back and restart the originals
A slow sign-in; rebuild DB-01 in another region
questions.explain: A failed check that cannot be fixed in the window triggers rollback, because DNS can be pointed back and the original servers were shut down, not deleted.
questions.zhExplain: 无法在维护窗口内修复的检查失败会触发回滚，因为 DNS 可以指回本地，而原服务器只是关机而没有删除。

questions.stem: If you propose a pilot, how can it be tested without disrupting dependent production systems?
questions.zhStem: 如果你提出试点，如何在不干扰依赖它的生产系统的情况下测试它？
options: A full migration with the original server shut down
An Azure Migrate test migration into an isolated Azure network
A test migration into the production virtual network
Dependency analysis on the replicated server
questions.explain: A test migration into an isolated network is correct, because it creates a copy while the original keeps running, so users and dependent systems are not affected.
questions.zhExplain: 迁移到隔离网络的测试迁移是正确的，因为它创建一个副本，而原服务器继续运行，所以用户和依赖系统都不受影响。

questions.stem: Which servers and workloads would you investigate?
questions.zhStem: 你会调查哪些服务器和工作负载？
options: Only WEB-01, because it is public-facing
Only DB-01, because it is mission-critical
All five, especially DB-01, FILE-01, and DC-01
Only servers already running in Azure
questions.explain: Investigate all five servers with extra focus on DB-01, FILE-01, and DC-01, because they hold the unknown SQL version, the legacy OS, and the identity and DNS role.
questions.zhExplain: 要调查全部五台服务器，并重点关注 DB-01、FILE-01 和 DC-01，因为它们分别涉及未知的 SQL 版本、过时的操作系统以及身份和 DNS 角色。

questions.stem: What additional information is needed from the organization to complete the assessment?
questions.zhStem: 还需要组织提供哪些额外信息才能完成评估？
options: The billing address of the Azure subscription
The OVA template version of the appliance
Office floor plans and desk numbers
Downtime limits, RPO/RTO, app versions and owners, and licenses
questions.explain: The organization must supply downtime limits, RPO/RTO, application versions and owners, and licenses, because discovery cannot read business requirements or license agreements from the servers.
questions.zhExplain: 组织必须提供停机限制、RPO/RTO、应用版本和负责人以及许可证信息，因为发现无法从服务器读取业务要求或许可协议。

questions.stem: Which dependencies can you identify between the servers?
questions.zhStem: 你能识别出哪些依赖关系存在于这些服务器之间？
options: APP-01 to DB-01, WEB-01 to APP-01, all to DC-01, users to FILE-01
DB-01 to WEB-01 only
None, because each server runs alone
DC-01 to FILE-01 only
questions.explain: The servers form a chain from WEB-01 to APP-01 to DB-01 and all use DC-01 and FILE-01, because the inventory says APP-01 depends on DB-01 and the other links follow the stated assumptions.
questions.zhExplain: 这些服务器构成 WEB-01 到 APP-01 到 DB-01 的链路，且都使用 DC-01 和 FILE-01，因为清单写明 APP-01 依赖 DB-01，其他连接则来自已声明的假设。

questions.stem: How do you clearly distinguish confirmed dependencies from assumed dependencies?
questions.zhStem: 你如何清楚地区分已确认的依赖关系和假设的依赖关系？
options: Confirmed ones are any you expect from the server roles
Confirmed ones are stated in the inventory; the rest stay assumed until validated
All dependencies count as confirmed once the diagram is drawn
Assumed ones are those Azure Migrate has already measured
questions.explain: Only APP-01 to DB-01 and users to WEB-01 are confirmed, because the inventory states them, while every other link stays assumed until dependency analysis validates it.
questions.zhExplain: 只有 APP-01 到 DB-01 和用户到 WEB-01 是已确认的，因为清单写明了它们，其他连接在依赖分析验证之前都只是假设。

questions.stem: What should a simple dependency diagram include?
questions.zhStem: 一张简单的依赖关系图应包含什么？
options: Only the VM sizes and monthly costs
Only server names in alphabetical order
Resource group names and tags
Servers, solid confirmed links, dotted assumed links, and the migration group
questions.explain: It shows the servers, confirmed and assumed links, and the migration group, because readers must see what is certain and what moves together.
questions.zhExplain: 它显示服务器、已确认和假设的连接以及迁移组，因为读者必须看清哪些是确定的、哪些要一起迁移。

questions.stem: What is the Readiness Category of WEB-01?
questions.zhStem: 就绪类别中，WEB-01 属于哪一类？
options: Not Ready, because Windows Server 2019 is out of support
Conditionally Ready, because it needs a secure endpoint, certificate, and DNS change
Ready, because a newer OS guarantees readiness
Insufficient Information, because IIS cannot run on Azure
questions.explain: WEB-01 is Conditionally Ready, because Windows Server 2019 and IIS run on Azure VMs but the public-facing site still needs a secure endpoint, certificate, and DNS change.
questions.zhExplain: WEB-01 属于有条件就绪（Conditionally Ready），因为 Windows Server 2019 和 IIS 可以在 Azure VM 上运行，但面向公网的站点仍需要安全端点、证书和 DNS 更改。

questions.stem: What is the Readiness Category of APP-01?
questions.zhStem: 就绪类别中，APP-01 属于哪一类？
options: Ready, because it has no dependencies
Not Ready, because Windows Server 2016 is already out of support
Insufficient Information, because its OS is unknown
Conditionally Ready, because it must move with DB-01 and needs vendor support confirmed
questions.explain: APP-01 is Conditionally Ready, because Windows Server 2016 is supported until January 2027 but it must move with DB-01 and its vendor support is unconfirmed.
questions.zhExplain: APP-01 属于有条件就绪（Conditionally Ready），因为 Windows Server 2016 支持到 2027 年 1 月，但它必须与 DB-01 一起迁移，且其厂商支持尚未确认。

questions.stem: What is the Readiness Category of DB-01?
questions.zhStem: 就绪类别中，DB-01 属于哪一类？
options: Insufficient Information, because the SQL Server version is unknown
Ready, because SQL Server always runs on Azure VMs
Not Ready, because mission-critical servers cannot migrate
Conditionally Ready, because it needs only a DNS change
questions.explain: DB-01 is Insufficient Information, because without the SQL Server version its support status and size cannot be judged.
questions.zhExplain: DB-01 属于信息不足（Insufficient Information），因为不知道 SQL Server 版本，就无法判断其支持状态和规格。

questions.stem: How would you justify your classification of DC-01 using the scenario and clearly stated assumptions?
questions.zhStem: 你会如何依据场景和明确陈述的假设，来说明对 DC-01 的分类理由？
options: Not Ready, because AD DS cannot run on Azure VMs
Ready, because Windows Server 2019 guarantees readiness
Conditionally Ready, because AD DS runs on Azure but a lone DC is a single point of failure
Insufficient Information, because its OS version is unknown
questions.explain: DC-01 is Conditionally Ready, because AD DS runs on Azure VMs but, under assumption A4, it is the only DC and a single point of failure.
questions.zhExplain: DC-01 属于有条件就绪（Conditionally Ready），因为 AD DS 可以在 Azure VM 上运行，但按假设 A4 它是唯一的域控制器，存在单点故障。

questions.stem: What information is needed to confirm your judgment of DB-01?
questions.zhStem: 需要哪些信息来确认你对 DB-01 的判断？
options: The number of users on WEB-01
SQL Server version, database size, IOPS, and RPO/RTO
The host name of the appliance only
The rack position of the server
questions.explain: The SQL Server version, database size, IOPS, and RPO/RTO are needed, because they decide support status, VM and disk size, and how much downtime DB-01 can take.
questions.zhExplain: 需要 SQL Server 版本、数据库大小、IOPS 和 RPO/RTO，因为它们决定支持状态、VM 和磁盘规格以及 DB-01 能承受多少停机。

questions.stem: What remediation or further assessment would you propose for FILE-01?
questions.zhStem: 你会提出什么修复或进一步评估来处理 FILE-01？
options: Leave it on-premises with no changes
Move it as-is and skip security patches
Upgrade the OS during migration, tested first
Delete it before discovery starts
questions.explain: Upgrade the OS during migration, because Azure Migrate supports upgrading Windows Server 2012 R2 to 2016 or 2019, and a test migration proves it first.
questions.zhExplain: 应在迁移时升级操作系统，因为 Azure Migrate 支持将 Windows Server 2012 R2 升级到 2016 或 2019，测试迁移可以先验证这一点。

questions.stem: What should you consider for each server?
questions.zhStem: 你应考虑每台服务器的哪些方面？
options: Only the OS version
Only the monthly cost
Technical compatibility, app requirements, security, OS support, and dependencies
Only the physical location of the server
questions.explain: Consider all five factors, because an older OS alone does not prove migration is impossible and a newer OS alone does not guarantee readiness.
questions.zhExplain: 要综合考虑这五个因素，因为较旧的操作系统本身并不能证明无法迁移，较新的操作系统本身也不能保证就绪。

questions.stem: Does an older operating system alone prove that migration is impossible?
questions.zhStem: 仅凭较旧的操作系统，能证明无法迁移吗？
options: Yes, any OS older than 2016 cannot run on Azure
No, it is a risk to assess, and an upgrade during migration may resolve it
Yes, Azure Migrate cannot discover older systems
No, because older systems never need remediation
questions.explain: An older OS alone does not prove migration is impossible, because support status, Extended Security Updates, and an OS upgrade during migration all change the outcome.
questions.zhExplain: 仅凭较旧的操作系统并不能证明无法迁移，因为支持状态、扩展安全更新以及迁移时的操作系统升级都会改变结果。

questions.stem: What configuration and utilization data is needed to recommend appropriate Azure VM sizes?
questions.zhStem: 需要哪些配置和利用率数据，才能推荐合适的 Azure VM 规格？
options: Only server names and roles
Only the Windows Server edition
Only the number of users
vCPU, RAM, disks, CPU and memory use, and disk IOPS and throughput
questions.explain: Sizing needs configuration plus average and peak utilization, because Azure Migrate matches the actual CPU, memory, and disk load of each server to a VM size and disk type.
questions.zhExplain: 确定规格需要配置以及平均和峰值利用率，因为 Azure Migrate 会把每台服务器实际的 CPU、内存和磁盘负载匹配到 VM 规格和磁盘类型。

questions.stem: Why is the provided inventory insufficient to produce reliable estimates?
questions.zhStem: 为什么现有清单不足以得出可靠的估算？
options: It lists too many servers for Azure Migrate
It has no CPU, memory, disk, or usage data, nor the SQL Server version
It uses server names that Azure does not accept
It includes a domain controller, which cannot be priced
questions.explain: Any size or price now would be a guess, because the inventory has no CPU, memory, disk, or usage data and not even the SQL Server version.
questions.zhExplain: 现在给出的任何规格或价格都只是猜测，因为清单没有 CPU、内存、磁盘或使用数据，甚至没有 SQL Server 版本。

questions.stem: What prerequisites are needed before migrating production workloads?
questions.zhStem: 需要先具备哪些前提条件，才能迁移生产工作负载？
options: Azure network, VPN, finished assessment, RPO/RTO, backups, and maintenance windows
Deleting the on-premises servers
Buying new on-premises hardware
Turning off dependency analysis
questions.explain: The Azure network, VPN, finished assessment, agreed RPO/RTO, backups, and maintenance windows must be in place, because production servers can only move safely once the landing zone and a way back exist.
questions.zhExplain: Azure 网络、VPN、完成的评估、商定的 RPO/RTO、备份和维护窗口都必须到位，因为生产服务器只有在目标环境和回退手段都存在后才能安全迁移。

questions.stem: What would you migrate or test first and why?
questions.zhStem: 你会先迁移或测试什么？为什么？
options: DB-01, because the most critical server should go first
DC-01, lifted and shifted as a normal server
All five servers in one weekend
A test migration of FILE-01 with its OS upgrade
questions.explain: A test migration of FILE-01 comes first, because it is outside the application group and its 2012 R2 upgrade must be proven early.
questions.zhExplain: 先对 FILE-01 做测试迁移，因为它不属于应用组，而且它的 2012 R2 升级必须尽早验证。

questions.stem: How would you confirm that migrated services work correctly?
questions.zhStem: 你会如何确认迁移后的服务正常工作？
options: Check domain join, DNS, the HTTPS site, APP-01 to DB-01, data, and file shares
Check that the Azure bill was issued
Confirm only that the VMs appear in the portal
Wait one month for user complaints
questions.explain: Validate each service end to end, because a VM that boots can still fail at sign-in, DNS, the website, the database connection, or the file shares.
questions.zhExplain: 要端到端验证每项服务，因为能启动的 VM 仍可能在登录、DNS、网站、数据库连接或文件共享上出错。

options: Yes, if they look reasonable
